purpose: Separate one captured steady no-MTP target chain into GPU intervals after completing the uninstrumented confirmation.
interpretation: One captured chain is not a request total. Different ranks overlap. P2 includes consumption and waiting, not pure PCIe copy. Native compute includes non-ALU work. Nested tail_compute must not be added again. A missing steady capture is reported rather than inferred.
stop_rule: Run only after the preceding confirmation exits normally, with the same five-card idle and exclusive GPU lock gates. No reset or tolerance change.
